name: Pierburg US, LLC.
old_description: In order to meet the complex challenges of the future with mobile solutions, Rheinmetall also has a product range that hardly any other manufacturer of military vehicles can offer. Our customers can therefore count on essential services beyond the equipment: individually tailored system logistics, global spare parts management and training programmes for all vehicle types.
about:
Pierburg US, LLC is based in Fountain Inn, South Carolina. The company's online presence points to Rheinmetall AG, a German integrated technology group focused on security and defence. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in the available sources.

The group operates as a cross-domain systems supplier, offering products and services for land, sea, air, and space domains. Its capabilities include training and service, test centres, aviation systems, logistics engineering, and technical publication services. Manufacturing activities encompass mechatronics, laser systems, and production of F-35A centre fuselage sections. The group reports approximately 5.1 million employees across 534 sites, with a backlog of €3.178 trillion and sales of €68 billion (figures as of December 2025).

Served industries include automotive propellants, chemical and pharmaceutical intermediates, and the broader security and defence sector. Customers range from military forces such as the German Air Force and Ukrainian armed forces to commercial aviation and industrial clients.

Rheinmetall emphasizes tailored system logistics, global spare parts management, and comprehensive training programmes as key differentiators, aiming to provide security as a foundation for peace and sustainability.
